title: mut.concept_dark_ecology
mutation_directive: Channel Timothy Morton's DARK ECOLOGY — art reckoning with hyperobjects (climate, mass extinction, deep time) at human scale. Translate: bind the piece to a slow real or simulated trajectory that exceeds human pacing — geological-time particle drift, exponential CO₂ growth curve as a deformation field, mass-extinction count as a particle-cull rate, pre-Cambrian → present timeline as a slow morph. The viewer should feel SCALE THEY CAN'T HOLD. Palette: muted earth tones bleeding into dead grey; never spectacle. A small running counter (years elapsed in piece-time, particles culled, etc.) reminds the viewer of what they cannot see directly.
